text.description_html:
Bommer 5082-400 4" x 4" x 5/8" Radius Stainless Steel Door Hinge

Standard plain bearing 4" stainless steel door hinge. Medium duty door hinge, standard .13" thickness. Full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips. BHMA certified architectural grade hinges. Made in the USA.

Specifications: for Bommer 5082-400-630 Hinge

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: 5/8" Radius
  • Thickness: 0.13"
  • Hinge Material: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8133 Hinges
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
